thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: spike detected — gateway 502/504 error rate increased to 4.8% over the last 5m (baseline 0.3%). Affected route: /v1/generate. Pager sent to #oncall.
Alice Moreno: I’m on it — pinging infra and app teams. Can someone grab initial blast radius?
Carla Singh: I’m seeing a big increase in upstream timeouts to model-proxy (latency + upstream errors). 5xxs correlate with proxy timeouts ~1200ms.
Ben Chu: quick data: ~2.1k requests/min, error = 102/min now. Top status=502 from gateway, 30% of failed requests show no trace IDs in logs.
Emily Park: important — a handful of customers (acme-corp, medsys) reported timeouts. Not widespread but high-value.
Alice Moreno: thanks. Ben — are traces missing because of sampling or header drop?
Ben Chu: sampling low, but headers also seem stripped at ingress LB for a fraction. Our trace-id-pipeline shows drop rate ~28% when requests hit the new envoy fleet.
Dave O'Neill: that matches my observation — envoy filter we rolled yesterday strips x-request-id when the health check path is present. Might be a config mismatch for the new listeners.
Carla Singh: we don’t have quick spans in the gateway logs for those requests either. Observability gap is making root cause hard. Need a stopgap to re-add request-id and surface more debug logs without a full deploy.
Alice Moreno: plan: 1) apply temporary middleware at app layer to backfill request-id and log full headers for failing requests; 2) enable 100% trace sampling on a small canary subset (5% traffic) to gather spans; 3) rollback new envoy config if metrics don't improve in 15m. Thoughts?
Ben Chu: +1. For the middleware I can push a hotpatch using the runtime flag `ENABLE_INSTRUMENTATION=on` and a kubectl rollout restart of the app pods. Minimal change.
Dave O'Neill: would prefer a config patch on ingress, but hotpatch is faster. Provide exact commands and I’ll approve.
Ben Chu: command (will run as infra-admin):
```
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/api-service ENABLE_INSTRUMENTATION=true
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/api-service
```
Middleware snippet (Node/Express):
```
app.use((req,res,next)=>{
  const id = req.headers['x-request-id']|| uuid.v4();
  req.headers['x-request-id'] = id;
  if (res.statusCode >= 500) {
    console.error('DBG_HEADERS', {id, headers:req.headers});
  }
  next();
});
```
Carla Singh: will add a guard so we only emit full headers for requests with 5xx and service="gateway" to limit noise.
Alice Moreno: Emily — can you call out customers impacted and flag any open SLAs?
Emily Park: acme-corp support case 3421 marked as P1. Medsys flagged degraded — raising CS to notify them we're on it.
deploy-bot: `deployment/api-service` rollout started by Ben Chu (rev=gradual).
Ben Chu: enabling trace sampling on canary:
```
# update tracing config map
kubectl -n prod patch cm tracing-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/sampling_rate","value":"1.0"},{"op":"add","path":"/canary_percent","value":"5"}]'
```
Dave O'Neill: I'll monitor envoy logs and if x-request-id is backfilled we'll check span joins. If not, I’ll queue a rollback of the envoy listener change.
Alice Moreno: handing pager to Ben — I need to hop to a customer call. Ben you’re primary, Dave secondary. @Carla help with logs + aggregation. Keep this thread updated every 5m. :thumbsup:
Ben Chu: taking primary. Running the env set + restart now. ETA ~90s for pods to roll.
Carla Singh: started a live grep on logs and shipping a short pipeline to stdout -> splunk for 5xx with `x-request-id` present: `kubectl logs -l app=api-service -n prod --tail=200 | jq -r \"select(.status>=500)\" > /tmp/5xx.log`
Ben Chu: done. Rollout succeeded on 3/3 pods.
deploy-bot: `deployment/api-service` successfully rolled out (rev=gradual)
Ben Chu: initial check: 5xx rate dropped to 2.3% in first minute. Some requests still missing traces.
Dave O'Neill: envoy still dropping a subset — I’m toggling a listener flag to preserve incoming `x-request-id` for passthrough traffic. Doing a config apply now (quick patch).
Carla Singh: logs after hotpatch show header backfill working for many of the previously missing ones — now only ~6% missing trace IDs.
Emily Park: customer comms: emailed Acme team acknowledging degraded calls; they requested ETA for full fix. Suggested 30-60m window.
Alice Moreno: I’m back. Good work. Keep monitoring for 30m; if 5xx <0.5% we de-escalate. Otherwise rollback envoy change and consider capacity spike mitigation (burst pool).
Ben Chu: adding a short-lived metric dashboard and alert threshold to reduce noise while we stabilize.
Carla Singh: note: follow-up action item — add integration test to gate envoy listener changes and a canary that verifies header passthrough. Filing ticket after incident.
Alice Moreno: filing incident report stub now. Thanks team — update in 5.
incident-bot: Incident assigned: SEV2 — owners: Ben Chu (primary), Dave O'Neill (secondary), Alice Moreno (overseer).
